findings.finding_text: L3 finally collects the probe-battery verdict and evidence-write failures into a local `problems` array but the settleRun call omits it — a failed or allRefused:false battery ships GREEN (AC5/INV-M3-2 negative control dead).
findings.label: BLOCKER
findings.rationale: Confirmed by direct read; fix includes problems in both settleRun arms.

findings.finding_text: L2 asserts in-box kg_recall from [kg-recall] stderr lines in harvested artifacts, but the worker chain discards worker stderr on success (runner stdio ignore-stderr; team-lead-driver logs stderr only when worker text is empty) — the assert can never see events; every green round fails L2.
findings.label: BLOCKER
findings.rationale: Re-seam: assert the dispatch_task worker_output (harvested trace/trace.db worker_output event) quotes the recalled marker content; stderr scan becomes record-only; observability gap filed as follow-up issue.

findings.finding_text: No pre-spend check that the pinned QDS_EXEDEV_SHA tree carries config/rosters/memory-live.roster.yaml; in-box loadRoster reads the ctx.sha checkout while the host gate checks the working tree — spend fires then the phase refuses in-box.
findings.label: MED

findings.finding_text: Printed worst-case spend says box <= 1h while the summed leg ceilings are ~8.7ks (~2.42h) of box exposure.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: State the leg-sum ceiling honestly in the L0 and pre-fire prints.

findings.finding_text: AC7 requires no divergent alarm on same-subject re-emit; the alarm is log-only in link-store and the walk cannot see it — assert the re-harvest verb's stderr is free of `divergent`.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Add stderr grep assertion on the re-harvest verb.

findings.finding_text: ttl probe fires 1.5s past expiry measured on the TEST HOST clock vs the DEPLOYED GATEWAY clock; gateway clock lag flips the probe to refused:false with no clock evidence.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Widen skew to 5s (cap 30s), record expiresAtMs + firedAtMs in the outcome evidence.

findings.finding_text: Observability Contract's server-duration sub-timing is never recorded; a leg that did not run must report absent, not 0.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Record serverDurationMs as explicit absent markers in the in-box-recall evidence.

findings.finding_text: Evidence mislabels: envFileBytes is actually chars; the dispatch .catch records dispatch-verb-timeout for non-timeout spawn failures.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Rename to envFileChars; split label with a timedOut flag.

findings.finding_text: listedKeyHashes().not.toContain(closed.keyHash) is vacuous when keyHash is undefined.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Guard closed.keyHash non-empty before the toContain assert.

findings.finding_text: kgRecallEvents rawControlChars flags a CRLF \r as payload control char.
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: Comment in the vendor test wrongly says node:test applies options.timeout as a no-op; node:test honors it natively.
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: Battery unit CLI-spawn test rides bun's 5s default with no explicit ceiling (the same class the failure-recovery fix addresses).
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: Cross-run probe is a duplicate of bank-allowlist (same keyA, same token, keyB never fired).

findings.rationale: Story-mandated construction: Deviation-2/AC5 explicitly wants probe (b) built from two driver-minted run keys so the scenario is distinct from (c); the gateway's scope check is allowlist-membership so the same token is the expected result.

findings.finding_text: DoD names cleanup verified on pass, fail, and interrupt paths; SIGINT mid-test skips finally — no in-test mechanism exists (repo-wide property; memory-cycle same shape).
